name: Model Pack
author: Paycei
description: 3D models: a ship skin, energy bolt bullets and a voxel desktop cube to equip in MODS.EXE > Cosmetics, and a Model Viewer app (MODS.EXE > Apps) that can swap the Circle enemies for an animated drone. Shows assets.model, register.cosmetic with a model, draw.model and override.model.
